name: steer
description: Engineering standards for GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code). This manifest loads steer's skills; .github/copilot-instructions.md (installed by /steer:init) carries the always-on rules, alongside the cross-tool .agents/skills/ tree in the open Agent Skills format. Hook enforcement is guaranteed on Claude Code only - the Copilot CLI and Copilot Chat in VS Code run the plugin's Claude hooks.json directly and pick it up incidentally, with no parity promise.
